title: Private Intake
user: Small field-service teams that need a booking form to collect client details while ensuring assigned workers see only the information needed to do the job.
smallest_useful_product: Hosted booking form and staff view with field-level roles (admin, assigned worker), a minimal job brief, redaction preview, and deletion date.
success_measure: 100% of configured private fields are absent from worker views while 90% of workers can open a complete permitted brief before an appointment.
constraints: Server-enforced field-level authorization; minimized PII retention; deletion/export; regional privacy notices; no booking identifiers in logs.
